message.content:
**LOGO / BRANDING**
> **Celsius**
> *Experts in keeping things cool*
> (Logo features the word "Celsius" in a bold, dark blue sans-serif font. To the left of the text is a stylized icon resembling a swirl or airflow symbol. Below the brand name is a tagline in smaller font.)

**HEADLINE**
> **DOMESTIC SOLUTIONS**
> (Text is large, bold, and uses a gradient color transitioning from light cyan/teal on the left to a darker blue on the right.)

**SUB-HEADLINE**
> **Home Comfort with Celsius:**
> (Text is dark grey, bold, and slightly smaller than the main headline.)

**BODY TEXT - INTRODUCTION**
> Discover personalized air conditioning solutions for your home with Celsius. We take pride in ensuring your space is not just comfortable but energy-efficient, equipped with cutting-edge technology. Our curated selection includes renowned brands like Midea, Haier, and Panasonic, offering the perfect blend of style, functionality, and eco-conscious design.

**BODY TEXT - KEY FEATURES**
> Key features include flexibility, smart integration, energy efficiency, and improved air quality.

**BODY TEXT - APPLICATIONS**
> Applications range from living spaces to home offices, providing personalized comfort and health benefits.

**BODY TEXT - VALUE PROPOSITION**
> Celsius ensures cost savings and reliability, making homes comfortable, efficient, and well-suited for modern living.

**BODY TEXT - CALL TO ACTION / CONCLUSION**
> Transform your living experience with Celsius – where comfort meets efficiency and well-being

**VISUAL ELEMENTS / GRAPHICS**
> *   **3D Isometric Illustration:** A detailed cutaway view of a modern apartment or house layout showing various rooms including a bedroom, living room, dining area, kitchen, and bathrooms. The style is clean and architectural.
> *   **Background Graphic:** A large, abstract shape in the bottom right corner consisting of overlapping curves in light blue and cyan, creating a "wave" or "cool air" aesthetic.
> *   **Page Number:** A dark blue rounded square in the bottom left corner containing the number "**09**" in white text.

**BRAND NAMES & MODEL NUMBERS MENTIONED**
> *   **Midea**
> *   **Haier**
> *   **Panasonic**

**COLOR SWATCHES (Observed)**
> *   **Primary Blue:** Dark navy blue (used for logo, page number background).
> *   **Gradient Cyan-to-Blue:** Used for the main headline "DOMESTIC SOLUTIONS".
> *   **Light Grey:** Used for sub-headline and body text.
    *   **Accent Blues/Cyans:** Various shades used for the background graphic wave.
